_comment: LLM-authored document spec. The exporter is a thin renderer: it applies THIS file, not hardcoded styling. Copy to docs/<mode>/_document.json, then edit any field to fit the report, audience, and language. Delete a field to fall back to the neutral default. Regenerate a fresh starter anytime with: python scripts/export_report.py --emit-spec --mode <mode>.
title: {{DESCRIPTIVE_READER_FACING_TITLE}}
_fonts_note: Font faces are filled per OS when omitted: macOS (Helvetica Neue + PingFang SC), Linux (DejaVu Sans + Noto Sans CJK SC), Windows (Calibri + Microsoft YaHei). PDF CJK uses reportlab CID fonts (no system install). Unicode symbols embed the best available system TTF (Arial Unicode / DejaVu / Noto / FreeFont). Override latin/eastasia/pdf_* here when you want fixed faces across machines.
_attribution_note: Product credit appears only in the page footer (not the cover). Set attribution.enabled=false (or footer.attribution=false) to hide. Override attribution.text for a custom line; null uses the default ('Powered by oh-my-research').
